latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update pytest requirement from ~=9.1 to ~=9.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4692
* Update python-engineio requirement from <5,>=4.14.0 to >=4.15.1,<5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4693
* Update flask-socketio requirement from <6,>=5.7.0 to >=5.7.2,<6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4689
* Update pydantic requirement from <3.0,>=2.14.1 to >=2.14.2,<3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4690
* Update ruff requirement from >=0.17.2 to >=0.17.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4691
* Update jsonpath-ng requirement from ~=1.14.0 to ~=1.16.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4703
* Update python-socketio requirement from <6,>=5.17.0 to >=5.18.1,<6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4701
* Update selenium requirement from ~=4.51.0 to ~=4.52.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4702
* MCP OAuth - ChatGPT can sign in: private_key_jwt client authentication (RFC 7523) by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4707
* LLM - Don't log a misleading "refused" warning for local LLM endpoints by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4708
* Update authlib requirement from <2.0,>=1.9.4 to >=1.9.5,<2.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4706
* Update pydantic requirement from <3.0,>=2.14.2 to >=2.14.3,<3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4704
* Update ruff requirement from >=0.17.3 to >=0.17.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4710
* Mark a restock watch as viewed when its watch list chart is opened by @atipapp in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4698
* Plugins - one core watch_last_viewed_updated hook for every "watch was viewed" path by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4711
* Plugin hooks for changing the request and per-watch plugin settings by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4712
* Apprise notifications 2.2.0 - Update requirements.txt by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4713

## New Contributors
* @atipapp made their first contribution in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4698

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/compare/0.70.2...0.70.3
